pnpm: overrides go inside the existing pnpm object, after its other keys.
-- changes --
[{"name":"semver","ecosystem":"npm","to":"7.7.2","method":"override","file":"package.json"}]
-- in:package.json --
{
  "name": "app",
  "pnpm": {
    "onlyBuiltDependencies": [
      "esbuild"
    ]
  },
  "dependencies": {
    "vue": "^3.5.0"
  }
}
-- in:pnpm-lock.yaml --
lockfileVersion: '9.0'
-- out:package.json --
{
  "name": "app",
  "pnpm": {
    "onlyBuiltDependencies": [
      "esbuild"
    ],
    "overrides": {
      "semver": "7.7.2"
    }
  },
  "dependencies": {
    "vue": "^3.5.0"
  }
}
